name: juist
comment: Peer-to-peer mesh VPN with no coordination server
desc:
juist is a Tailscale-like mesh VPN with a WireGuard data plane and no central
control plane: membership, key distribution, revocation and rendezvous are
peer-to-peer. This package installs the CLI, the node daemon, and an rc.d
script that runs the daemon as a dedicated user beside a helper as root that
sets up its devices, routes and pf rules.

messages.message: juist: sysrc juistd_enable=YES, then service juistd start
juist: service juistd restart runs the new juistd
